key_targets_per_feature.damage_multiplier: EnemyHealth.TakeDamage(Transform, DamageRequest, out DamageResult) RVA 0x269F900 — multiply DamageRequest.damage @0x10. Enemy hp is a plain float @0xAC.
key_targets_per_feature.god_mode: HeroHealth.TakeDamage(Transform, DamageRequest, out DamageResult) RVA 0x277D940 — hook and return early. HP is ObscuredFloat @0x28 (ACTk), do NOT write raw HP.
key_targets_per_feature.item_dropper: ItemDropManager.SpawnItem(Vector3, Item, ItemInstance) RVA 0x2874718 (overloads 0x2874724, 0x287472C, 0x2874B10). Resolve Item at runtime from ItemInRMDatabase/InvDatabase.FindByID. LootType: Item=0, Gold=1, Ruby=2.
key_targets_per_feature.skill_no_cooldown: HeroControl.UpdateSkillsCooldown() RVA 0x2766164 (choke point) or zero HeroControl.allSkillCooldown float[] @0xF0; EC2HeroSkill.ApplyCooldown RVA 0x263C6B8; gate CanUseSkill RVA 0x276FFF8.
key_targets_per_feature.teleport_quest: QuestManager.currentQuest @0x30 -> Quest.targetAreaNode @0x20 -> scene QuestMarkerNode Transform (get_transform RVA 0x25CA0D0) -> Transform.set_position RVA 0x4FDBEC8. Target position NOT proven statically — needs dynamic test.

limitations: Per-item stats (sellPrice, baseRarity, maxRarity, baseStats, upgrade materials) are NOT enumerable from the shipped APK: 0 ScriptableObject objects exist in all local bundles (bin/Data + aa/Android). Item data lives in remote-only Addressables bundles (CDN https://ec2cdn.gacogames.com/v1/Android/, catalog catalog_2026.10.09.11.24.54). items.json therefore enumerates item identities (asset names = Item.id) with heuristic type classification, NOT stats. The injector must resolve items at runtime from the game's loaded database.

Quest target position storage is NOT proven statically: NavigationNode has no position field; the marker position is the QuestMarkerNode GameObject's Transform in the live scene. Teleport-to-quest and teleport-to-monster need dynamic verification on the device.

Per-class assembly attribution is unavailable from dump.cs: all 114 '// Image N:' header lines sit at the top of the file, so classes.json/methods.json have img=null; the 114 image names are listed in this file instead.
The dumper logged 'WARNING: find JNI_OnLoad' / 'ERROR: This file may be protected', but the dump completed fully (128,038 RVA lines; 99.8% of methods parsed).
script.json has 239,474 ScriptMethod entries vs 128,038 definitions in dump.cs — the extra entries are generic instantiations with separate addresses; dump.cs (128k) is the canonical definition list.

RVAs are file-relative to this libil2cpp.so build (from the MOD repack, though libil2cpp.so appears identical to the official game). Verify against the official Play Store libil2cpp.so before shipping; use pattern-scan for update resistance as planned.
Player HP is ACTk ObscuredFloat — plain memory writes to HP are unreliable; hook TakeDamage instead. Enemy HP is a plain float.

Item classification in items.json is heuristic (name patterns); confidence is recorded per item. 1,286 catalog assets are non-item (quests, skills, enemies, dialogues, databases, shop/deal definitions).
source_caveat: Source APK is the v3.1.5 MOD repack, BUT per the earlier REA report the mod is additive (DEX 3 + libmenu.so + one smali line) and libil2cpp.so + global-metadata.dat appear identical to the official game, so the dump was done from those files. No clean official APK was found/used. RVAs are for this libil2cpp.so build; the official Play Store build may differ — verify RVAs against the official libil2cpp.so before shipping the injector.
